# stock-fetcher

> Unified copyright-free stock photography search and download CLI, Python SDK, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash, and Flickr.

## Core Capabilities
- Non-blocking asynchronous HTTP querying across multiple providers using httpx.
- Zero-configuration Flickr scraper targeting Creative Commons licensed media.
- Multi-tier in-memory and disk caching honoring HTTP Cache-Control headers.
- Strongly typed Pydantic v2 response schemas (StockImage).
- Built-in FastMCP stdio server for AI agents in Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Antigravity.

## Installation
- Homebrew: `brew tap AtaCanYmc/tap && brew install stock-fetcher`
- Python: `pip install stock-fetcher[all]`

## Documentation & Manuals
- [Home & Live Showcase](https://atacanymc.github.io/stock-fetcher/): Interactive terminal simulator and asset gallery.
- [API Keys Guide](https://atacanymc.github.io/stock-fetcher/api_keys_guide.html): Step-by-step instructions for obtaining free provider keys.
- [CLI Manual](https://atacanymc.github.io/stock-fetcher/cli_manual.html): Complete command arguments, options, and shell recipes.
- [MCP Manual](https://atacanymc.github.io/stock-fetcher/mcp_manual.html): Configuration guide for AI agent integrations.
